question: Which shared MLPs are conditionally necessary in causal layer order and in the full recurrent context, and can one module be deleted while preserving both task programs and improving controls?

authority.pairwise_boundary: Pair interactions are concentrated among MLP0-4 but the complete degree-two reconstruction has negative projection and RSE above 2.9, selecting ordered/full-context conditional increments.

novelty: First ordered-prefix, singleton, and full-context leave-one-out causal atlas of the shared eight-MLP two-task writer bank, with control-scored first-step greedy deletion.
decision: Choose a deletion only among arms preserving both rank-four task responses and behaviors. Prefer a fully selective arm; otherwise retain the functional arm with the best frozen control frontier as a non-released next greedy state.
